sentences.en: He made heaps of money by ripping off naive suckers.
sentences.zh: 他通过欺骗天真的人赚了大量钱。

sentences.en: You do not have to pile everything in one heap.
sentences.zh: 你不需要把所有东西都堆在一起。

sentences.en: My friend spoke heaps without taking any break about himself.
sentences.zh: 我的朋友滔滔不绝地讲自己，根本不停下来喘口气。
